hypothesis: A cut-blind language-model extractor run over a public-domain pre-1905 electrodynamics corpus surfaces the absolute-simultaneity / privileged-frame / local-time-artifice family at the 1904 cut and not at the 1880 deep-placebo cut, indicating the extraction tracks the corpus rather than the model's own knowledge of what happened in 1905.

controls.description: Identical pipeline over Maxwell-only sources, predating any ether-drift null result. A target-family hit here cannot come from the corpus.
Null results present, Lorentz 1904 and Poincare 1904 absent. Recorded as a graded observation with no gate, because no calibrated expectation exists for it.

Extraction runs per document with a byte-identical prompt; the extractor never sees the year, the cut, another document, or the research question. Cuts are composed afterwards, so any leakage is introduced equally at all three cuts.
Every extracted proposition carries a source span that is mechanically checked against the document. No agent is trusted to have copied accurately.
A term is residue iff the extractor emits it and the corpus at that cut lacks it. Replaces a blocklist, which was shown to fail in both directions on this corpus.

The two Poincare documents reached via Halsted's 1913 compilation carry every sentinel term at the 1904 cut. Every analysis runs with and without them; the French originals were checked independently.
Wikisource header templates link every source to Portal:Relativity. Chrome is stripped structurally at fetch time rather than by keyword.

gates.criterion: At least 90% of extracted propositions carry a quote present in the source document under whitespace normalisation.
Residue rate below 5% of output word types at every cut.
The 1880 cut does not surface the target family, i.e. fewer than two of the three facets are present.
The 1904 cut surfaces the target family, i.e. at least two of the three facets are present.
